label: start
name: starting architecture
last_analysis: All 9 trials scored 0 on dev, and none built a single design exactly during training. That covers different recipes, trunks, per-layer scorers, dense heads and attention heads, so neither the network body nor the action layout looks like the bottleneck. A shared cause is more likely: the agent almost never chooses DONE. Every build overshoots, because any placement after completion adds extra cells, and the 33-placement limit never lines up with an exact finish. To succeed, the agent must choose DONE right after completion. But DONE is 1 logit among about 1,000 legal placements, so at the start it is sampled roughly 0.1% of the time. The entropy bonus over this large action space also pushes DONE's probability back toward about 1/1000. So the +1 bonus is never seen. All three candidates this round add a gated DONE head: p(DONE) comes from a sigmoid, and the placements share the remaining probability. Around that change they vary the entropy coefficient, the credit horizon and the trunk.
